title: How Vice City Shaped Rockstar's Formula Ahead of GTA6
description: Explore the wild behind-the-scenes stories of GTA: Vice City, how Rockstar established its legendary formula, and what it means for GTA6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Wild Origins of Rockstar's Formula

As the gaming community eagerly looks toward the horizon for the release of GTA6, looking back at the foundational pillars of the franchise reveals just how far Rockstar Games has come. According to recent retrospectives from Eurogamer, *Grand Theft Auto: Vice City*—the game that truly cemented Rockstar's killer formula—was born out of high-stakes passion, vibrant 1980s aesthetics, and occasionally, real-world drama.

One of the most remarkable anecdotes from the game's development involves legendary actor Burt Reynolds during a recording session. Upon seeing Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser enter the studio, Reynolds famously shouted to the producers, "Get the limey out of here! I'm not going to work if this limey Brit is in here!" Rather than backing down, Houser—who had simply come down to meet one of his heroes—stood his ground. The confrontation escalated to the point where Houser and Reynolds ended up chest-to-chest, nearly coming to blows before a studio engineer stepped in to break up the fight.

## Connecting the Past to GTA6

This intense studio clash perfectly encapsulates the uncompromising, high-energy environment that birthed some of the greatest video games in history. Vice City established a blueprint featuring star-studded voice casts, pitch-perfect period soundtracks, and a satirical, immersive open world that captivated millions.

While Rockstar has evolved significantly over the past 24 years, the foundational drive that led executives and Hollywood legends to butt heads in a recording booth remains a core part of the studio's identity. This relentless pursuit of excellence and willingness to push creative boundaries is precisely why anticipation for GTA6 is unprecedented in the history of entertainment.

## Editor's Take

Behind-the-scenes tales like the Dan Houser and Burt Reynolds confrontation remind us that the magic of classic games comes from real human passion and friction. As Rockstar prepares to redefine the open-genre yet again with GTA6, that same uncompromising creative DNA will undoubtedly be the driving force behind its success.
